tools.name: Frontman
tools.shortDescription: Open-source visual AI agent for web apps
tools.description: Frontman is an open-source visual AI agent for editing running web apps from the browser. It supports Next.js, Astro, and Vite apps, works with Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, and compatible providers, runs in local development, and produces normal source-code diffs. Best for visual UI changes on existing applications.

tools.name: OpenRouter
tools.description: OpenRouter provides access to 29 free models including Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen3.6-Plus, Nemotron 3 Super, MiniMax M2.5, and Devstral 2. Routes requests to various providers with a single API.
cons: Free tier limits shared across models

tools.name: Groq
tools.description: Groq provides the fastest inference for LLMs with speeds up to 2,000 tokens/sec. Offers generous free tiers for multiple models with excellent rate limits.

tools.name: Google AI Studio
tools.description: Google AI Studio provides free access to Gemini models including Gemini 3 Flash and 3.1 Pro. Simple web-based interface and API access. Note: Gemini 3.1 Pro may be paid-only for some tiers.
cons: Data used for training outside UK/CH/EEA/EU

pricing.freeTier: 250 RPD (Tier 1) for most, 1,500 RPD for Gemini 3 Flash

tools.name: NVIDIA NIM
tools.description: NVIDIA NIM provides hosted inference for 46+ models including Llama 3.3, Llama 4 Scout, Mistral Large, and Qwen3 235B. Phone verification required. Models tend to be context window limited.

pricing.freeTier: 1K credits signup, up to 5K total, 40 RPM (phone verify required)

tools.name: Cerebras
tools.description: Cerebras offers ultra-fast inference on specialized hardware with 1.5M tokens/day free tier. Excellent for high-throughput applications. Now features Qwen3.6-Plus-480B at 2,400 t/s.

tools.name: Mistral La Plateforme
tools.description: Mistral's official platform with access to Mistral Large 3, Small 3.1, Codestral, and Pixtral. Free tier requires opting into data training and phone verification.

tools.name: GitHub Models
tools.description: Access 30+ models including GPT-5.5, Claude, Llama, and Gemini through GitHub Models. Now requires Copilot subscription — no longer usable as standalone free API.

tools.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
tools.description: Run 47+ models on Cloudflare's global edge network. 10,000 neurons/day free allocation with generous rate limits.

tools.name: OfoxAI
tools.shortDescription: Unified API gateway with free GLM-4.7-Flash
tools.description: Unified API gateway for 100+ LLMs. OpenAI and Anthropic SDK-compatible. China-friendly with Hong Kong direct access (100-300ms latency). No monthly fees, pay per token.

pricing.paidTier: Pay per token for premium models

tools.name: OpenCode Zen
tools.shortDescription: 8 exclusive free Zen models including Big Pickle
tools.description: AI gateway with curated free models via OpenCode Zen. Includes Big Pickle Stealth (72% SWE-bench), MiniMax M2.5 Free (80.2% SWE-bench), MiMo V2 Pro/Omni/Flash Free, and more.
cons: Data may be used for improvement

pricing.freeTier: Zen Free tier with 8 exclusive models

tools.name: Cursor
tools.description: The leading AI-native IDE with autonomous coding capabilities. Features Agent mode, tab predictions, and multi-file editing. Credit-based billing since Jun 2025.

pricing.freeTier: Limited Agent requests + limited Tab completions/mo + 1-week Pro trial
pricing.paidTier: Pro $20/mo ($16/mo annual), Pro+ $60/mo ($48/mo annual), Ultra $200/mo ($160/mo annual)

tools.name: Trae
tools.shortDescription: VS Code-based IDE with DeepSeek V4 and GPT-5.5-Instant
tools.description: ByteDance's AI IDE with competitive pricing. 5-tier token system (effective Feb 24, 2026). Offers DeepSeek V4, GPT-5.5-Instant, Gemini 2.5 Pro.

tools.name: Windsurf
tools.description: Formerly Codeium. Multi-provider IDE with access to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and xAI models. Quota-based pricing since Mar 19, 2026.

pricing.freeTier: Light daily/weekly quota, unlimited Tab completions, 1 app deploy/day

tools.name: Qoder
tools.description: Alibaba's AI IDE featuring Qwen3.6-Plus (71.2% SWE) and GPT-5.5-Instant. Unlimited completions in free tier with limited chat/agent. 50% launch promo ended Apr 30, 2026.

pricing.freeTier: Unlimited completions + limited chat/agent + 2-week Pro trial

tools.description: AWS's spec-driven agentic IDE and CLI — official replacement for Amazon Q Developer (EOL Apr 30, 2027). Features Claude Fable 5, Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5 via AWS Bedrock. Spec-driven development with requirements.md → design.md → tasks.md workflow.

tools.name: Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan
